0.7.2 is a drop-in patch for 0.7.0 and 0.7.1: format epoch 3 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot or Raft protocol change. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`). No fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Server memory no longer grows with uptime** ([#507](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/507)). A replication read returns at most 4 MiB of entries and a replication message stays under about 8 MiB, so the gRPC streams between voters no longer keep buffers of hundreds of MiB after a burst of large writes. After the same load on a three-voter test cluster, the replication buffers a node kept fell from between 1.2 and 1.7 GB to about 0.4 GB. `/__ursula/metrics` reports the largest message sent as `raft_grpc_append_stream_frame_bytes_max`.
- **Rust library API changed.** `ursula_raft::RaftGrpcMetricsSnapshot` has a new field, `raft_grpc_append_stream_frame_bytes_max`.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518) and [#519](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/519). Every change is listed in the [0.7.2 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#072).
